title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
description:
🚀 WE ARE HIRING | Graduate Engineer Trainees (GET) – Freshers
  
  
Company: UPS Lakshmi
  
Location: Kharawar, Rohtak, Haryana
  
Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site
  
Experience: Freshers (0–1 Year)
  
Interview Mode: Face-to-Face Interview
  
  
UPS Lakshmi is looking for enthusiastic and motivated Graduate Engineer Trainees (GETs) to join our team for a new project. We invite applications from fresh engineering graduates who are eager to learn, develop technical skills, and build a career in the manufacturing industry.
  
  
📌 Open Positions:
  
  
- GET – Design
  
- GET – Development
  
- GET – Procurement
  
- GET – Quality Management System (QMS)
  
  
🎓 Eligibility Criteria:
  
  
- B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
  
- Freshers and candidates with up to 1 year of experience can apply.
  
- Strong technical knowledge and problem-solving abilities.
  
- Good communication, analytical, and teamwork skills.
  
- Willingness to learn and work in a manufacturing environment.
  
- Candidates from Rohtak and nearby locations will be preferred.
  
  
🛠️ Key Responsibilities:
  
  
- Assist respective departments in daily engineering and project-related activities.
  
- Support design, product development, procurement, or quality management processes, depending on the assigned role.
  
- Coordinate with cross-functional teams to support project execution.
  
- Maintain technical documentation and follow company procedures.
  
- Learn and implement engineering best practices under the guidance of experienced professionals.
  
  
📍 Interview Process:
  
Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a face-to-face interview at UPS Lakshmi, Kharawar, Rohtak, Haryana.
  
  
📩 How to Apply:
  
Interested candidates can share their updated resumes via LinkedIn DM or email at upsarchitajain@gmail.com
  
  
Please mention your preferred department (Design / Development / Procurement / QMS) while applying.
  
  
Join UPS Lakshmi and take the first step toward building your engineering career!

title: SME - SDWAN
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced SD-WAN Subject Matter Expert (SME) to lead multi-vendor SD-WAN operations, provide technical leadership, manage customer escalations, and ensure compliance with defined KPIs, SLAs, security standards, and operational processes.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing SD-WAN solutions across Cisco, Fortinet, Cisco Meraki, and Versa platforms, ensuring network availability, service performance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. The role also requires strong expertise in MPLS, ISP connectivity, routing protocols, underlay and overlay troubleshooting, controller management, and technical team development.
  
  

* Key Roles and Responsibilities
* SD-WAN Technical Leadership

Act as the technical SME and lead for multi-vendor SD-WAN technologies, including Cisco, Fortinet, Cisco Meraki, and Versa.
  
  
Provide technical leadership for SD-WAN deployment, migration, upgrades, configuration changes, and service assurance.
  
  
Review and validate High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs), and Method of Procedures (MOPs).
  
  
Troubleshoot complex underlay and overlay connectivity issues, routing instability, tunnel failures, and application performance problems.
  
  
Drive root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive measures for recurring network incidents.
  
  

* Day-to-Day Network Operations

Oversee daily SD-WAN and WAN operations across enterprise managed services environments.
  
  
Ensure proactive monitoring, incident management, problem management, and change management.
  
  
Manage SD-WAN controllers, orchestrators, management platforms, and associated components.
  
  
Coordinate network upgrades, device replacements, configuration changes, and planned maintenance activities.
  
  
Ensure network availability, stability, and service continuity across customer environments.
  
  

* KPI and SLA Management

Track and review operational KPIs, SLAs, MTTR, incident trends, availability, and service performance.
  
  
Ensure incidents, service requests, and changes are resolved within agreed SLA timelines.
  
  
Prepare periodic operational dashboards, performance reports, and management reviews.
  
  
Identify service improvement opportunities and drive corrective and preventive actions.
  
  

* Partner and OEM Governance

Manage service delivery and technical governance with OEMs, ISP partners, and third-party service providers.
  
  
Conduct regular OEM support reviews, technical discussions, and service performance assessments.
  
  
Coordinate critical escalations, hardware replacements, software upgrades, and defect resolution.
  
  
Track vendor commitments, pending actions, RCA submissions, and permanent corrective measures.
  
  

* Customer and Escalation Management

Handle critical customer escalations and major network incidents.
  
  
Lead technical bridge calls and coordinate resolution across internal teams, OEMs, ISPs, and service partners.
  
  
Communicate incident updates, service restoration plans, and RCA findings to customers and management.
  
  
Maintain strong customer relationships through effective communication, ownership, and timely resolution.
  
  

* Network Security and Compliance

Ensure compliance with operational processes, security policies, change management, and audit requirements.
  
  
Conduct security audits of managed network devices, including routers, firewalls, and SD-WAN appliances.
  
  
Coordinate vulnerability assessments, firmware and software compliance reviews, and security remediation activities.
  
  
Track security advisories, vulnerabilities, configuration deviations, and remediation closure.
  
  
Ensure compliance with approved configuration baselines and operational security standards.
  
  

* Team Development and Cross-Functional Collaboration

Build technical capabilities within L1.5 and L2 operations teams through training, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  
  
Develop troubleshooting guides, standard operating procedures, and technical documentation.
  
  
Collaborate with engineering, service delivery, project, security, and other cross-functional teams.
  
  
Drive operational standardization, automation opportunities, and continuous service improvement.
  
  
Position Specific Skills
  
  
Hands-on experience in SD-WAN technologies, preferably Cisco SD-WAN, Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, Cisco Meraki, and Versa.
  
  
Strong experience in MPLS, Internet Service Provider (ISP) connectivity, and enterprise WAN architectures.
  
  
**Strong Understanding Of Routing Protocols**
Static and dynamic routing
  
  
BGP
  
  
OSPF
  
  
EIGRP
  
  
IS-IS
  
  
Expertise in underlay and overlay troubleshooting, IPsec tunnels, routing convergence, path selection, and application connectivity.
  
  
Experience in SD-WAN controller, orchestrator, and centralized management platform administration.
  
  
Working knowledge of Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), including TACACS+ and RADIUS-based device administration and access control.
  
  
Experience in network security audits, vulnerability assessment, firmware compliance, and remediation tracking.
  
  
Strong knowledge of incident, problem, change, and configuration management processes.

title: Content Manager
description:
**About Company:**

Newton School of Technology (NST) is a new-age institution redefining technical education in India. Founded by IIT alumni, NST offers a 4-year B.Tech in Computer Science and AI, focused on hands-on learning and deep industry integration. Within two years, over 93% of students have secured paid internships with companies like Razorpay, SarvamAI, and DRDO, along with global exposure through tech treks to Singapore and Silicon Valley. Led by a distinguished faculty comprising ICPC World Finalists and ex-professionals from ISRO, Microsoft, MakeMyTrip, and several other leading tech organizations, NST is building a scalable, high-impact model that produces industry-ready talent for the world’s most advanced technology roles.

**About the role:**

We are looking for a
**creative and strategic Content Manager**
to lead the development of compelling content, impactful campaigns, and engaging brand storytelling across platforms. In this role, you will be responsible for crafting high-quality content, managing social media presence for Newton School of Technology, and collaborating with cross-functional teams (design team, Video editing team, and more) to quickly roll out high impact content and strengthen our brand presence

If you're a creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, marketing, and education, we'd love to have you help shape the future of learning.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Develop compelling copy and scripts for Newton School of Technology’s YT & IG (long form and short form) that align with the brand's voice and objectives.
* Conduct market, audience, and competitor research to identify trends and generate relevant content ideas.
* Managing Social Media end-to-end and thinking in terms of posting relevant content and growing the channels.
* Creating and managing content calendars, and managing the posting.
* Optimising content for SEO on YouTube, writing high search intent content (titles, description, video tags, meta tags and thumbnail copies).
* Collaborate closely with designers, videographers, marketers, and other stakeholders to bring campaigns to life.
* Adapt writing style and tone to suit different platforms, audiences, and communication objectives.
* Ensure all content maintains a consistent brand voice, is accurate, and meets high editorial standards.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while delivering quality work within deadlines.
* Stay updated on industry trends, emerging content formats, and best practices to continuously improve content effectiveness.
* Attend and cover for social media campaigns for events held for business purposes and plan and produce live content (stories, reels, carousels).

**Requirements :**

* 3–7 years of experience in content strategy, social media, copywriting, or a similar role, preferably with a brand, creative agency, or marketing team.
* A strong portfolio showcasing creative, performance-driven, and brand-focused content across multiple formats.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with exceptional attention to grammar, editing, and proofreading.
* Strong storytelling ability with a keen eye for detail and consistency in brand messaging.
* Working knowledge of SEO principles and content optimization best practices.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong project management and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities.
* A genuine passion for creativity, storytelling, marketing, and staying ahead of industry trends
* Strong communication skills and preferable experience in student communications or EdTech.

title: Academic Counsellor
description:
**Company Description**
The Narayana Group is an education organization focused on unlocking the potential of learners through continuous learning and empathetic guidance. Inspired by a legacy of determination and the belief that every individual holds boundless potential, Narayana aims to turn aspirations into achievable goals. The institution emphasizes not only academic excellence but also personal growth, using experience and empathy as key drivers. At Narayana, education is treated as a catalyst that helps students and families move closer to their dreams, living the philosophy that “Your dreams are our dreams.”
  
**Role Description**
The Academic Counsellor role at The Narayana Group in Ballabgarh is an on-site position focused on guiding students in their academic journey and overall development. The Academic Counsellor will meet with students and families to understand their goals, provide academic and career-related counselling, and help create personalized study plans. Responsibilities include monitoring student progress, addressing academic and personal challenges, coordinating with teachers and administrative staff, and conducting information sessions or workshops on educational pathways. The role also involves maintaining accurate counselling records, supporting admissions-related queries, and offering consistent, empathetic guidance aligned with the institution’s values.
  
**Qualifications**

* Ability to provide Student Counseling and Academic Advising to support learners’ educational and personal development.
* Strong Communication skills to interact effectively with students, families, and faculty.
* Experience or training in Career Counseling to guide students on academic and professional pathways.
* Background in Education or related fields to understand curricula, assessment methods, and learning needs.
* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Psychology, Counseling, or a related discipline (master’s degree or certification in counseling is an advantage).
* Empathetic, patient, and student-centric approach with strong listening and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work collaboratively with academic staff and handle confidential information responsibly.
* Prior experience in academic counselling or school/university settings is preferred.

title: UAV Design Engineer (CFD & FEA Specialist)
description:
**Position: UAV Design Engineer (CFD \& FEA Specialist)** 




**Location:** 
 Manesar, Haryana
 



**Experience:** 
 3\-6 years
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on Design Engineer to join our core engineering team and drive the design, development, testing, and optimization of next\-generation drone and UAV systems.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is a practical, field\-tested engineer with strong expertise in
 **mechanical design, UAV structures, aerodynamics, CFD, materials, and manufacturing** 
 \- someone who has independently taken UAV components or complete systems from concept through
 **CAD, analysis, prototyping, manufacturing, testing, and real\-world field deployment** 
 , not just theoretical or simulation work.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**UAV \& Mechanical Design** 




 • Independently design UAV/drone airframes, structural components, and mechanical sub\-assemblies.
 



 • Develop production\-ready 3D models and 2D engineering drawings (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, AutoCAD, or equivalent).
 



 • Own designs end\-to\-end — from concept through prototyping, manufacturing, and field deployment.
 



 • Balance weight, strength, stability, durability, and manufacturability in every design decision.
 



 • Partner with electronics, flight\-control, and systems teams on integration and weight distribution.
 



 • Reverse engineering capabilities to scan a model and prepare the design with required modification.
 



**Aerodynamics \& CFD** 




 • Apply practical aerodynamics and fluid mechanics knowledge to real UAV flight scenarios.
 



 • Run CFD simulations (ANSYS Fluent/CFX or equivalent) to optimize lift, drag, stability, and efficiency.
 



 • Translate simulation results into concrete design changes.
 



 • Diagnose and resolve aerodynamic issues that surface during actual flight testing, not just on paper.
 



**Manufacturing \& Materials** 




 • Select materials (carbon\-fiber composites, high\-strength polymers, lightweight alloys, aerospace\-grade materials) based on strength, weight, cost, and durability requirements.
 



 • Apply design\-for\-manufacturing (DFM) principles to keep designs production\-ready and repeatable.
 



 • Coordinate with fabrication teams on CNC machining, 3D printing, and composite molding.
 **Testing \& Field Validation** 




 • Validate designs through prototyping, ground testing, and flight testing.
 



 • Use field feedback and test data to drive continuous design iteration.
 



 • Demonstrate a track record of designs that are personally developed and currently operating in the field \- not shelved prototypes.
 



**Documentation \& Compliance** 




 • Produce detailed engineering drawings, specifications, and BOMs.
 



 • Ensure designs meet applicable engineering, safety, and regulatory standards.
 



 • Maintain configuration control and documentation throughout the product lifecycle.
 



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 • Work closely with flight\-control, electronics, manufacturing, and operations teams to resolve design and performance issues.
 



 • Support fast design iteration cycles based on test data and operational needs.
 



  





**Required Qualifications \& Skills** 




 • Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace, Aeronautical, Mechanical, or Mechanical Design Engineering, or a related field.
 



 • Proven, independent ownership of UAV/drone mechanical and structural designs — not just design support.
 



 • Demonstrable experience with UAV components or systems that have been manufactured, tested, and deployed in the field.
 



 • Strong practical grounding in aerodynamics, fluid mechanics, and UAV structural design.
 



 • Proficiency in SolidWorks, Fusion 360, AutoCAD, or equivalent CAD tools.
 



 • Hands\-on CFD analysis experience using ANSYS Fluent/CFX or equivalent.
 



 • Working knowledge of composite materials, lightweight structures, CNC machining, and additive manufacturing.
 



 • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to turn theory into flight ready hardware.
 



  





**Preferred** 




 • FEA/structural and multi\-physics simulation experience.
 



 • Experience with fixed\-wing UAVs, multirotors, VTOL, or other autonomous aircraft.
 



 • Direct experience working with manufacturing/fabrication teams and running flight tests.
 



 • Background in aerospace, defence, aviation, drone, or robotics industries.
 



 • Strong technical communication skills.
 



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




 Someone who can point to a real design lifecycle they've owned:
 **Design → Analysis → Manufacturing → Testing → Field Deployment.**
